title: Census truncation closed by floor-only denominator semantics; the enumeration bound is not raised or paginated

rationale: MAX_SIBLING_SOURCE_SCAN_FILES = 4096 is the hard per-repository contract ceiling enforced on every enumeration limit.
The approved scan config already pins mobingilabs/ouchan to that ceiling (4096 files / 48,000,000 bytes under the 64,000,000 byte ceiling) and Ouchan still truncates.

enumerateFiles aborts at the cap (truncated=true, truncationReason=SOURCE_FILE_COUNT_EXCEEDED) and returns no cursor or resumable state, so pagination would require a new resource contract rather than an existing one.
The walk charges every considered directory entry, so a larger cap is not a bounded guarantee either.
decision.chosenClosure: floor-only denominator semantics for every yield metric consuming the source inventory, reusing src/core/source/completeness.ts vocabulary
